general.summary: Attackers are exploiting an authentication flaw (CVE-2026-58115) in Node-RED, a programming tool built into some industrial control products, to install a Linux bot and backdoors on unprotected servers, VulnCheck has found. Node-RED is a flow-based programming tool built on Node.js that lets users wire together event-driven applications in a browser-based editor. It can run on small devices such as the Raspberry Pi or in the cloud, and it is used in manufacturing, healthcare, and home … More → The post Attackers exploit critical Node-RED flaw to deploy Linux bot and backdoors (CVE-2026-58115) appeared first on Help Net Security .
